parameters.name: networkRef
parameters.description: The network's own reference for the demand.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Client-generated key (a UUID per logical submit; a retry of the same submit reuses it), 1-128 printable ASCII characters. The first answer (2xx or 4xx) is stored for at least 24 hours and replayed for the same method, path and body with `Idempotency-Replayed: true`; a different request under the same key is a 409 `idempotency-key-reused`. A 5xx is never stored.
